name: gtin-product-markdown
title: GTIN / UPC / EAN → Product Markdown Card
description: Look up GTIN/UPC/EAN barcodes via UPCitemdb or Barcode Lookup (bring your own key) with Open Food Facts as a keyless food/FMCG fallback. One Markdown product card (+ optional RAG chunks) per barcode. 256 MB. Not-found & failed rows free. No Idealo/Amazon scraping.
